# CaliforniaMailer

CaliforniaMailer is an owner-managed direct-mail project evaluating an experimental shared-mailer planning scenario for candidate Monterey Peninsula geography. No carrier routes or residential delivery counts are selected.

## Current pre-launch posture

- Campaign state: pre-launch unless the database-backed campaign board publishes a later state
- Active plan: `shared-9x12-5000`, offer model version `shared-mailers-v2`
- Proposed format: experimental 9 × 12 on 14 pt stock
- Planning quantity: 5,000 pieces; this is not a selected-route address count or delivery promise
- Mailing areas: public candidate geography is searchable at `/mailing-areas`; exact route counts appear only when the public API returns a current verified route-plan snapshot
- Proposed inventory: experimental 24-unit layout concept; no unit is offered for purchase from this static document
- Customer price and funding goal: withheld in this static document. The request-time `/pricing` page must evaluate current dated evidence and otherwise require a written quote
- Checkout and payment: disabled until a 24-unit physical template passes indicia, address-space, branding, disclosure, bleed, safe-area, and legibility review, and until current supplier pricing, routes, complete economics, policies, and provider configuration are approved
- Production status: no payment may be accepted and no print order may be placed from the catalog model alone
- Results: no response, lead, appointment, sale, or ROI promise

Customer amounts are deliberately absent because a static artifact cannot expire supplier evidence. HRM first-party guidance describes roughly 16–18 ads as comfortable on a 9 × 12 and about 25 on a 12 × 15, so the requested 24-unit 9 × 12 is not production-proven.

## Shared-mailer model catalog

The catalog contains internal dated planning-price assumptions for experimental 9 × 12 scenarios at 5,000 and 10,000 pieces. This static document does not publish them. The request-time `/pricing` page may show a planning amount only while its supplier snapshot remains inside the configured evidence window and its safeguards clear the fixed $2,500 pre-income-tax surplus floor and 20% economic-margin floor. Other shared-mailer examples—including 12 × 15, adjustable M6/M7–9, targeted M3, community, new-mover/Sparker, and directory formats—remain model-specific and quote-only. Custom price mixes use a required total revenue and average benchmark, not a uniform customer price.

Requests for single-business EDDM, targeted-addressed mail, and small partner-mailer planning may be submitted for project-specific review. An inquiry does not establish availability.

## Operating model

The intended sequence is asynchronous interest review, category check, physical template and economics preflight, campaign publication, hosted checkout only if activated, materials intake, versioned proof approval, print-readiness checks, and delivery documentation. A public reply mailbox remains unpublished until its identity and delivery are verified.
